nodes.name: 🔔 Inbox Outlook Trigger
nodes.notes:
Branch A — incoming customer emails.
No subject filter here — hard stop is in 📧 Normalize Incoming Email (subjectNormalized !== 'tooba feedback').
output:raw passes full Graph API payload.
TODO: Select Microsoft Outlook OAuth2 credential.

nodes.name: 📧 Normalize Incoming Email
nodes.notes:
v4 hard-stop: returns [] for ANY non-exact-match subject.
Exact filter: subjectNormalized === 'tooba feedback' only.
Re: / Ответить: / Fwd: / FW: / any prefix → [].
Also stops on: no messageId, no conversationId, isDraft, empty/system sender, cleanBody < 3.

nodes.name: 💬 Post Request to Slack
nodes.notes:
Posts incoming request card to C0ATU9ZD2UF (#support_ai_test).
Response .ts is stored as thread_ts for sent-reply tracking.
TODO: Select Slack credential. TODO: Update channel ID for production.

nodes.name: 🧷 Store Slack Thread Mapping
nodes.notes:
Saves conversationId → { channelId, threadTs, requestId, senderEmail, subject, originalMessageId, storedAt } in $getWorkflowStaticData('global').
Branch A ends here — no further nodes.

nodes.name: 📤 Sent Outlook Trigger
nodes.notes:
Branch B — manager sent replies.
Polls SentItems (Microsoft Graph well-known folder name).
output:raw passes toRecipients, sentDateTime, conversationId.
TODO: Same OAuth2 credential as Branch A.
If 'SentItems' folder fails in UI, try 'Sent Items' or 'Отправленные'.

nodes.name: 📧 Normalize Sent Reply
nodes.notes:
v4: matches conversationId from staticData. Returns [] if no match.
Dedup via processedSentMessageIds ring-buffer (max 500).
strips quoted reply history via stripQuotedHistory().
Strips Outlook mobile footer 'Получите Outlook для…'.

nodes.name: 🔎 Find Slack Thread Mapping
nodes.notes: Validates slackChannelId, slackThreadTs, sentReplyText all present. Returns [] otherwise.

nodes.name: 🧵 Post Final Reply to Slack Thread
nodes.notes:
Posts manager reply ONLY in thread via thread_ts — not as new main channel message.
TODO: Select Slack credential.
If thread_ts does not appear under otherOptions in your n8n version, move to additionalFields.
